Sam (Sales): yes. reps just need a one-liner, a 30s discovery line, and two quick zingers vs cloud vendors.
Noor (Product Marketing): angle: 'migration risk reduction' — highlight reserved capacity, safe rollbacks, and verified cost delta.
Priya (Research): bench blurb: embedding pipeline cost down ~30% vs default infra; p95 tail stable under burst. will provide a 1-paragraph methods note.
Owen (Field): add procurement bullet: KMS/HSM support, audit logs, exportable traces. also a short vendor-exit FAQ.
Maya (Marketing): deliverables: 1) 1-liner + 30s script 2) 1-page PDF 3) webinar hook 4) subject line A/B. owners: Sam/Noor/Owen/Priya.
Sam (Sales): owning the sales lines. draft 1-liner: "Redwood Inference: migration-safe LLM serving 1 predictable costs, safe rollouts, enterprise controls."
Noor (Product Marketing): webinar hook idea: "Migrate models without surprise bills"  20-min case study + 30-min runbook demo.
launch-bot: Webinar hold placed: 2024-10-10 15:00 UTC (tentative). :calendar:
Priya (Research): will drop a tiny methods snippet and the raw numbers into this thread in ~2hrs.
